# Inert builder test fixtures

`good_pins.json` copies the upstream-verified recipe pins from `.wavemind/env/pins.json`; this fixture does not authorize a build. `placeholder_pins.json` intentionally contains placeholders and must be refused. `unapproved.json` has the measured SHA-256 of the literal `W8 unapproved negative recipe fixture\n`, not an approved production recipe. The leak Dockerfiles isolate the card's forbidden COPY/ADD instructions; never build them.

`fakebin` never forwards a command to the host. Set both `OSW_ROOT` and `OSW_FAKE_STATE` to isolated scratch directories. State persists in `state.json`, calls append to `calls`, and journal text appends to `journal` under the state directory. All emulated filesystem writes stay under `OSW_ROOT`. The root controller fixture must be seeded by the test. Account ownership is virtual, so tests need no privileges. Unknown operations fail closed.

Overrides: `OSW_FAKE_UID`, `OSW_FAKE_EUID`, `OSW_FAKE_VERSION`, `OSW_FAKE_AVAILABLE_VERSION`, `OSW_FAKE_EXTRA_GROUPS`, `OSW_FAKE_ARCH`, `OSW_FAKE_FAIL`, `OSW_FAKE_RC`, `OSW_FAKE_PROCESSES_REMAIN`. The pgrep fixture alone preserves the native no-match status as raw test input so the operator script can distinguish absence from probe errors; the operator script must still normalize its own exit. All other fixture failures use normalized codes. No fixture value is host telemetry.

`repo-identity.tree` is NUL-delimited `git ls-tree -r -l -z HEAD -- go.mod` data from the target OpenSuperficies checkout, plus synthetic empty, tiny, LICENSE and README rows. `repo-identity-go.mod` contains that real tracked blob. Synthetic rows test exclusions; they are not host measurements. Neither fixture authorizes a build.

The builder's `build --repo-pins <file> -` consumes a host-side JSON array. Each entry has `repo`, absolute host `path`, full lowercase Git SHA-1 `commit`, and optional absolute capsule `workspace`. The required names are `opensuperficies`, `vision-engine`, `wender-agent`, matched against recipe warm manifests. Paths/commits are intentionally not guessed: the current warm files do not supply them. Missing target pins fail closed with rc 4; malformed pins give rc 2. Git tree metadata is collected on the host, without checkout, network or reading blob contents; image payloads are hashed incrementally in RAM. Empty/tiny blobs and generic LICENSE/README documents are omitted. Toolchain and distro sources receive no extension veto and no exemption from identity matching.

New build records include `repo_identity: {size, sha256}` alongside `repo_code_in_image: 0`. The digest hashes sorted unique lowercase blob IDs with one LF after each ID. `CheckRecord` strictly validates this local evidence extension and validates the remaining base record against the frozen contract. External consumers using the frozen closed schema directly require the conductor's corresponding schema extension outside FB2's surface. Legacy records without evidence remain readable; new builds always emit it.
